subject: Mobile Development
title: Palm Pilot and the PDA Era
description: A short lesson to help you apply Palm Pilot and the PDA Era.

hook.text: Before smartphones, busy professionals carried PDAs — personal digital assistants.

buildup.text: The Palm Pilot launched in 1997 with a stylus-driven touchscreen and handwriting input.

discovery.text: It synced contacts and calendars with your PC via a cradle. Millions were sold.

twist.text: PDAs had no cellular radio. You still needed a separate phone to make calls.

climax.text: Palm showed that people wanted computers in their pockets, not just phones.

punchline.text: The PDA was a phone without the phone.

quiz.question: What did PDAs lack that phones had?
